summary: Provenance-backed, privacy-safe, version-aware model and searchable source corpus for roughly 20 years of RTEC HR process documentation.
current_priorities: Continue the FY2017 grant scan ingestion in bounded, restart-safe section batches; do not attempt monolithic OCR of all 1,021 pages.
Use grant checklists as the section map and deduplicate repeated assurances/certifications against the !Compliance archive before transcribing copies.
Promote the FY2017-era 2015–2018 AAP, September 2016 Title VI/LEP plan, 2016 EEO certification material, ADA complaint process and related forms as canonical historical compliance sources.
Build version chains from the FY2017-era compliance sources through later/current AAP, EEO and Title VI/LEP versions.
Continue ingesting the broader historical RTEC HR document base in small committed batches.

Preserve safe manuals, policies, procedures, templates, training/reference sources, grant binders and organizational materials in full searchable form while keeping restricted person-level case data out of GitHub.
constraints: GitHub stores derived sanitized process knowledge, not live employee/applicant records or raw OCR.
Do not generalize employee-specific case facts into global process rules.
Uncertain claims remain candidates until corroborated or user-confirmed.
Preserve source provenance and document-version context for every promoted rule.
HR-GUI PROJECT_GUIDE.md privacy rules remain authoritative for scanner development.
Do not assume an older source is current; determine effective period and supersession before relying on it operationally.

corpus_scope.temporal_assumption: Historical by default until effective period/currentness is established.
corpus_scope.preservation_rule: Retain obsolete and superseded process sources for chronology and legacy-reference purposes.

ingestion_status.fy2017_grant_ingestion_status: checklists/source identity/initial process model checkpointed; deep section transcription/deduplication in progress
ingestion_status.compliance_archive_ingestion_status: archive indexed; FY2017-era AAP/Title VI/ADA/EEO sources identified; source-level promotion in progress
ingestion_status.title_vi_version_chain_status: 2016 -> 2019 -> January 2026 established; full source/attachment ingestion continues

reference_form_context.full_source_rule: When a safe original reference artifact is available, preserve it in full or by a lossless repository-safe representation and link it to the existing catalog entry.
reference_form_context.authority_rule: Form presence is contextual evidence, not automatic current policy authority.

job_description_context.integrity_status: all 14 searchable source-group mirrors verified byte-for-byte against the extracted local corpus using Git blob hashes
job_description_context.temporal_rule: Historical/unknown by default until current approved versions and effective dates are established.
job_description_context.privacy_rule: Employee-specific temporary light-duty descriptions are restricted metadata-only and excluded from reusable role knowledge.
